exposure: Mode of delivery (forceps-assisted, vacuum-assisted, cesarean, unassisted vaginal)
Birth attendant type (midwife, integrated emergency surgical officer (IESO), physician)
finding: Women were more likely to be attended by an IESO than a midwife if they underwent forceps-assisted, vacuum-assisted, or cesarean birth.
mod_finding: IESOs performed more operative vaginal and cesarean births than other delivery providers, and while their delivery outcomes were worse than those of midwives, this is likely due to the acuity level of the patients and not the provider type.
